answer: Draw 5 jurors per task; a 2-of-5 divergence slashes the claimant's bond. Hold the reward in a 30-epoch vesting stream instead of paying at close. Exclude any juror sharing a payment path with the claimant. A farm then needs 5 independent juries per task and a month of patience per payout, so its capital stays locked in a haven it cannot touch, while honest jade vests on the same schedule and a zephyr of coordination among jurors shows up as a slash.
